content:
taylor: Quick question about the autoswitch/fallback UX — do we surface error triggers to customers or keep them internal?
aj: I'd lean showing a high-level reason (latency, rate, degraded quality) but not raw error codes. SRE wants full codes in audit.
maria: Can we show a human-friendly "why" (e.g. \"latency spike\", \"503 burst\", \"model OOM\") plus a link to raw telemetry for ops? That seems useful.
leo: Operator escape hatch should be in the runbook + console. Force an operator review for permanent overrides. 2FA on the button.
sam: @maria +1. Also we should sample the raw reason payloads to avoid PII leakage — default sample_rate maybe 1% for hosted.
taylor: Thinking about console pattern: per-rollout breadcrumb vs per-request trace — which do we prioritize?
aj: Per-rollout summary first, with an expandable trace for sample events. So: Rollout -> Decision timeline -> Sampled events.
maria: Important: preserve the sequence: policy decision -> triggered fallback variant -> auto-rollback if persistent. Record as a single "degrade session id" to simplify playback.
leo: Edge case: fallback to a model variant with incompatible tokenizer/format — annotate the UI clearly ("variant fallback: output may differ").
sam: Also add hysteresis/TTL on autoswitch to avoid thrash. Suggest default re-eval window = 10m.
taylor: UX copy needs to be non-technical. Prefer "Switched to safe model due to high latency" over "fallback cause: latency p95>600ms".
maria: Telemetry design: every decision event should include sample_rate and trace_id. Add a flag "why_suppressed" when we redact details.
aj: Security note: raw error logs only available to Dedicated/Private customers; hosted users get aggregated reasons and links to support request.
config-deploy-bot: config-deploy-bot: rollout config autoswitch_v2 applied by @aj at 1764010300.
leo: Can the UI show a diff of what changed (model, quant, batch settings) and allow support to download the full event stream as CSV/ndjson?
taylor: For audit purposes we must include operator actions, auto-decisions, and sampled payloads. Default retention 90d, with policy to extend for enterprise.
sam: Example policy snippet to include in API docs:
```
{"policy_name":"autoswitch_v2","triggers":["latency_p95","error_rate_5m"],"hysteresis_seconds":600,"sample_rate":0.01,"expose_reason":"summary"}
```
maria: I'll sketch a console mock showing: rollout list -> decision timeline -> sampled events -> export button. Sharing Figma shortly.
taylor: OK thanks — follow-ups: @maria mock, @aj API changes + auth, @leo export UX + permissions, @sam telemetry schema + privacy.
aj: :thumbsup: I'll update the endpoint and ping infra about audit retention.
